items.criterion: The health read returns a ready status.
The apartment list returns only released apartments.
items.judgment: The apartment list answers 200 and carries no coming-soon apartment.

items.criterion: The apartment list narrows by typology combined with bedroom count.
items.judgment: The filtered list answers 200 and carries only apartments matching both filters.

items.criterion: The apartments sort by interior area alone.
items.judgment: The area sort orders by interior area and ignores terrace area.

items.criterion: A released apartment reads back in full.
items.judgment: The apartment read answers 200 with its record.

items.criterion: A released apartment floor plan streams from the stored object under its key.
items.judgment: The floor plan read answers 200 and the object exists in the store under the plan key.

items.criterion: A callback submission records the apartment reference and contact details.
items.judgment: The submission answers 201 and one callback row carries the apartment reference and contact details entered.

items.criterion: A sales user reads the callback requests.
items.judgment: The sales callbacks read answers 200 with the requests.

items.criterion: The public index reconciles with the released rows.
items.judgment: The listed apartments match the released rows in the database.

items.criterion: Releasing a coming-soon apartment opens its public read.
items.judgment: After release the apartment reads back to the public in the index.

items.criterion: A first-visit cookie choice survives a reload.
items.judgment: The cookie preference persists and the notice is not shown again after a reload.

items.criterion: A signed-out request for a sales endpoint is refused.
items.judgment: The anonymous sales request answers 401 with not-signed-in.

items.criterion: A callback missing a required field is refused.
items.judgment: The invalid callback answers 400 or 422 with something-missing-or-wrong and writes nothing.

items.criterion: A public read of a coming-soon apartment is refused.
items.judgment: The coming-soon apartment read answers 404 with no-such-thing.

items.criterion: A public read of a coming-soon floor plan is refused.
items.judgment: The coming-soon floor plan read answers 404 with no-such-thing.

items.criterion: An illegal availability step is refused.
items.judgment: The illegal availability change answers 409 with the-rules-dont-allow-that and the apartment is unchanged.

items.criterion: Each public route answers a distinct document title.
items.judgment: No two public routes answer the same title.
